retrievalProfile.description: A close-up candid portrait of a man in a cowboy hat framed by a continuous perimeter of elegant serif typography.
excludeWhen: modern sans-serif tech aesthetics are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A warm, intimate close-up of a smiling man wearing a dark cowboy hat, where the composition is defined by a rectangular border of text that runs along all four edges of the square frame.
coreVisualRelationships: Text acts as a physical border for the central subject
Warm skin tones contrast against the deep black of the hat
The downward gaze of the subject creates a sense of humility and warmth
The gold typography complements the warm highlights on the face
coreInvariants: Text aligned to the extreme edges of the canvas

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale close-up, head and shoulders, slightly off-center to the right, looking down.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's smile and the dark mass of the cowboy hat.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the text border in a clockwise motion before settling on the subject's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal, primarily the dark areas of the hat and shirt.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark blues in the clothing and hat.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm flesh tones and golden highlights on the skin.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale gold or cream for the perimeter typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark background/clothing and the bright, warm facial features.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thicks and thins
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used in different orientations to create a unified frame.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary high contrast and sharp serifs.
Offers an elegant, fashion-forward serif look.
Captures the classical, almost Roman stone-carved elegance.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a warm-toned, close-up candid photograph of a man with a gentle smile wearing a black cowboy hat and a dark button-down shirt, looking down and to the side. The lighting should be soft and golden.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a high-contrast serif font in all-caps around the four edges of the image. The top text is upright, the right text is rotated 90 degrees clockwise, the bottom text is upside down (180 degrees), and the left text is rotated 270 degrees. Use a pale gold color for the text.

verificationChecks: Is the text placed at the very edges of the square?
Does the text rotate to follow the perimeter?
Is the subject wearing a cowboy hat?
Is the lighting warm and intimate?

adjustableVariables: Color of the text (Gold vs Silver)
mustRedesign: Do not use the specific name 'Clay Walker'
Do not use the specific phrase 'Live, Laugh, Love'
Avoid exact replication of the subject's facial features
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is perfectly aligned to the edges
Check that the rotation of the text follows a consistent clockwise or counter-clockwise flow
Verify the skin tones are warm and not washed out
Confirm the cowboy hat is a prominent compositional element
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a candid close-up portrait + Apply perimeter text frame + Use high-contrast serif typography + Apply warm golden color grading.
